title: loop-auth polish: freeze exported constants, tailor missing-bundle-dir error, fix fixture twin
description: LOW follow-ups from the TASK-075 review (2026-07-02). (1) UNATTENDED_PRESET and LOOP_AUTH_SWITCHES are exported mutable objects - a caller mutating the preset poisons every later grantUnattended in-process; Object.freeze both. (2) The absent-bundle error path where the pointer names a session whose bundle dir is missing surfaces a raw ENOENT from readBundleSession - tailor to a clear typed message and lock with a spec. (3) tests/e2e/operating-mode.spec.js still uses the invalid session-id fixture 20260616T120000Z-testbeef (non-hex chars) - fix to deadbeef for consistency (it is not ajv-validated there, so cosmetic).
acceptance_criteria: Object.freeze applied to UNATTENDED_PRESET and LOOP_AUTH_SWITCHES; a spec proves mutation attempts do not alter later grants.
Missing-bundle-dir path throws a clear error (session id + expected path) instead of raw ENOENT; regression spec red-green proven.
operating-mode e2e fixture uses a schema-valid session id; suite green.
